ACTk has secure layer for the PlayerPrefs: <color="#75C4EB">ObscuredPrefs</color>. It protects data from view, detects any cheating attempts, optionally locks data to the current device and supports additional data types.
ACTk has secure version of traditional binary file with few helpful APIs built on top of it to make it as easy to use as usual Player Prefs.
ACTk is able to detect some types of cheating to let you take action on the cheating players. This example scene has all possible detectors and they do automatically start on scene start.
